profile.headline: Helping local businesses find their growth pressure points · Strategic Advisor · Tech @ Fiserv
profile.summary: Witty software engineer and venturing entrepreneur looking to help people get to their next level in life! I have 5+ years of experience in the tech industry and web development is my true passion. I also build modern websites for small business owners.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: Understand, maintain, and enhance next gen proprietary banking core as a service. Assisting in onboarding and presenting new enhancements to clients
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Version Control · Core Banking · SQL

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
1. Architected and shipped core banking engine features in Go, supporting new transaction types for a platform used by multiple bank clients while maintaining SOC 2 / banking compliance requirements

1. Designed and implemented business logic and integration points for transaction processing, contributing to a platform handling thousands of transactions daily

1. Collaborated with product, QA, and cross-functional engineers across ~3-5 person sprint teams to deliver features meeting customer and regulatory requirements, with release timing adjusted based on QA validation cycles rather than a fixed schedule

1. Authored technical documentation adopted by support and delivery teams, reducing repeat clarification requests during solution delivery

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Web Services API · Front-End Development · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Problem Solving · Web Applications · Responsive Web Design · Communication · React.js · Test Coverage

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
1. Developed features for the Global Prepaid Platform, supporting prepaid card issuance and rebate programs for large enterprise clients

1. Built and tested new/updated APIs using Postman, supporting integrations for multiple internal and client-facing systems

1. Modernized legacy codebase to Spring + JPA, improving maintainability and reducing regression issues in affected modules

1. Delivered production React UIs from Figma designs, translating design specs into interfaces consuming company APIs

1. Wrote Jira stories and mentored 2-3 new engineers on sprint workflow, shortening their ramp-up to independent task ownership

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Front-End Development · Problem Solving · Web Applications · Responsive Web Design · Communication · Test Coverage

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
1. Earned COM SEC security clearance to maintain a military-grade encryption key management application with zero security incidents during tenure

1. Analyzed and optimized data using PL/SQL against Oracle databases; built and maintained test VMs in Workstation Pro to validate new features before release

1. Reached SME-level ownership of a full-stack application, managing everything from Java version upgrades to new UI development and functionality

1. Managed version control using Mercurial/Tortoise Hg across the development lifecycle for all assigned feature work

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description: I designed web services (Restful APIs) using mainly Java, SQL, Hibernate. And tested with SOAPUI. I also wrote technical design documents that explain how our web services (Resful APIs) are intended to work.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Services API · Problem Solving · Web Applications · Responsive Web Design · Communication · Test Coverage

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
1. Translated business requirements from the BSA team into web service designs, using Agile and Waterfall cycles depending on project scope

1. Authored Use Case Models and Behavior Diagrams to guide technical solution decisions for new business requirements

1. Independently tested services using SoapUI prior to handoff, reducing defects surfaced in later QA cycles

1. Selected as a member of WellCare's Center of Excellence team, contributing to org-wide technical best practices

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
1. Developed J2EE applications using Agile and Waterfall methodologies during an intensive technical training-to-deployment program

1. Applied Spring, Hibernate, REST, Angular, and SQL to deliver full-stack functionality from design through implementation

1. Planned project scope using Use Case Models, Behavior Diagrams, and class/package architecture

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: I learned tools and frameworks that I can use to build and develop enterprise technical solutions
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Web Applications · Responsive Web Design · Communication
